RMIT VIETNAM SGS

BUSINESS CLUB

RMIT Vietnam Business Club – SGS (BC), established in 2004, is one of the oldest academic clubs founded at RMIT. Our vision is to Nurture Future Business Leaders, achieved by sharpening club members’ business acumen and strengthening leadership.

  • Growth mindset
  • Leadership
  • Initiative
  • Critical thinking
  • Effective communication

MARKETINGTHE FACE OF BC

EXTERNAL RELATIONSTHE VOICE OF BC

HUMAN RESOURCESTHE HEART OF BC

Build a strong BC community by recruiting talent, developing future business leaders, and fostering members’ growth and belonging.

RESEARCH & DEVELOPMENTTHE BACKBONE OF BC

Strengthen BC’s foundation through research, internal development, process improvement, and business knowledge sharing.
